info.title: SourceMix
info.description: Collect .NET C# source files into an LLM-friendly Markdown context file, with both CLI and interactive TUI workflows.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Collects .NET C# source files into an LLM AI optimized Markdown file.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path. Defaults to stdout when not specified.

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recursively include files that define types referenced by the specified files. [default: False]

options.name: --depth
options.description: Maximum recursion depth when --recursive is used. Defaults to no limit. [default: 2147483647]

options.name: --include-compiled
options.description: Decompile interfaces and simple model types from compiled assemblies in bin/ for types not found in source. Requires --recursive and a prior dotnet build. [default: False]

options.name: --trim
options.description: Strip method bodies from dependency files, keeping type signatures only. Requires --recursive. [default: False]

options.name: --expand-types
options.description: Replace 'var' with inferred types and expand target-typed new() to include the type. Anonymous and unresolved cases are left unchanged. [default: False]

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Append a prompt personality to the output. Use a built-in key (nunit-test, xunit-test, code-review, tech-docs, explain, debug, refactor, architecture) or provide custom text.

options.name: --skills
options.description: One or more skill keys to prepend to the output. Each key is a subdirectory name in the skills config directory containing a SKILL.md file.

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: File paths or glob patterns of C# files to include (e.g. src/**/*.cs).
